query:
SELECT 
                c.id,
                c.username,
                c.display_name,
                c.bio,
                similarity(c.username, $1) as "rank!",
                COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) as "tip_count!",
                COALESCE(SUM(t.amount::decimal), 0) as "total_received!"
            FROM creators c
            LEFT JOIN tips t ON c.id = t.creator_id
            WHERE 
                c.username % $1
                OR c.display_name % $1
            GROUP BY c.id, c.username, c.display_name, c.bio
            ORDER BY "rank!" DESC
            LIMIT $2
